name: escape-ai
description: Runs backend/api, frontend, and the Python voice agent together for local development.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,frontend,agent -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend/api" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run agent"
scripts.agent: cross-env PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run --project backend/src/server python backend/src/server/bot.py
